problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into entering their login credentials on fake websites, leading to account compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization to gain access to sensitive information or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing attempts
Educate employees on recognizing social engineering tactics
Limit access privileges based on role and need-to-know basis

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive or vendor email accounts to authorize fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data disclosures.
risk_reduction: Verify payment requests through secondary communication channels
Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Monitor email account activity for unusual behavior or login locations

problems.description: Improperly configured cloud storage buckets or services that expose sensitive data publicly or to unauthorized users.
risk_reduction: Implement automated cloud configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies for cloud resources
Use encryption for data at rest and in transit

problems.description: Attackers infiltrate an organization by compromising software, hardware, or service providers in the supply chain to insert malicious code or gain access.
risk_reduction: Conduct thorough vendor risk assessments and continuous monitoring
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and integrity verification
Enforce strict access controls and network segmentation

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model parameters to degrade or control AI/ML system behavior, causing incorrect or malicious outputs.
risk_reduction: Use robust data validation and anomaly detection during training
Employ adversarial training and model hardening techniques
Monitor model performance continuously for unexpected behavior

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio/video) to impersonate trusted individuals and deceive targets in social engineering or fraud schemes.
risk_reduction: Train employees to recognize deepfake indicators
Verify communications through multi-channel authentication
Deploy AI-based detection tools for synthetic media

problems.description: Malware that operates in memory or uses legitimate system tools to evade traditional file-based detection mechanisms.
detection_methods: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) with Behavioral Analytics
risk_reduction: Deploy endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions with behavioral analytics
Implement application whitelisting and privilege restrictions
Regularly update and patch endpoint software
